tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Analysing Live Theatre

questions.question: What should you focus on when taking notes during a live theatre performance?
questions.correctAnswer: Specific moments, not general impressions. Record: what happened, which techniques were used, how the audience responded. Focus on performance (vocal/physical choices), design (set, lighting, costume, sound), direction (staging, pacing). Use precise terminology.

questions.question: Explain the difference between DESCRIBING a moment and ANALYSING it. Why does analysis score higher marks?
questions.correctAnswer: Description: 'The actor shouted loudly.' Analysis: 'The actor increased volume to a shout and broke previously measured pacing, conveying the character's loss of control and shocking the audience into attention — this marked the peripeteia of the scene.' Analysis earns marks because it explains MEANING and EFFECT.

questions.question: How would you structure your analysis of a key moment from a production you have seen?
questions.correctAnswer: Identify the moment precisely; describe the theatrical techniques used; explain the intended effect on the audience; evaluate how successful the choices were; link to the production's overall intentions. Use the SEE framework throughout.
